title: Khoon Ankhou Sai Rawan, Soch Pay Chaie Hai Rida
body:
Kyun Tere Sar Sai Hoi Chadar E Tatheer Juda
<<DIVIDER>>
Takht Kai Samne Baithi Hai Zameen Pai Zainab,
Ru Ba Ru Zainab Kai, Qatil E Shabeer Kharra
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghaib Naizay Sai Agar Sar Hai, Na Marro Mujko,
Milayga Baba Wahin, Jis Jagga Akbar Houga
<<DIVIDER>>
Amma Fiza Ab Hat Ja Tu Mere Aagey Sai,
Cheer Dalay Ga Issay, Haideri Khutba Mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Shidat E Dard Sai Ankhou Kai, Sabhi Parde Phattay,
Chashmay Sajjad Sai Youn, Khoon Hai Bahar Nikla
<<DIVIDER>>
In Bazarou Kai Liye Mere, Hi Takhleeq Hoie,
Ro Kai Zainab Kahay, Shaam Main Ghairat Ka Khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
Benamazi Ussay Kehta Hai, Tu Kum Zarf Nahin,
Jisko Sajda Bhi Karay, Kabba Samjh Kar Sajda
<<DIVIDER>>
Binte Haider Nai Jalalat Main, Jou Khamoosh Kaha
Louh E Mahfooz Talak, Chaya Mukammal Sakta
<<DIVIDER>>
Kho Gayi Bheer Main Mere Jou, Sakeena Adil,
Dil Main Ghairat Ka Toufan, Hotou Pai Marne Ke Dua.
